question: The difference between the simple interest and the compound interest, compounded annually, on a certain sum of money for 2 years at 10% per annum is ₹407. Find the sum [rounded off to the nearest integer].
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective CI rate for 2 years = 10% + 10% + (10 × 10) ÷ 100% = 21%

Effective SI rate for 2 years = 10% × 2 = 20%

Difference in interest rates = 21% − 20% = 1%

Given 1% of Principal = ₹407

⇒ Principal = 407 × 100 = 40700

**∴ The correct answer is ₹40,700.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Difference between compound interest and simple interest (D) = ₹407

Rate of Interest (R) = 10% per annum

Time period (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Difference between CI and SI for 2 years: D = P × (R ÷ 100)²

 
 Principal (100%)
 
• 
 
• 
 
 Yr 1 Int: 10%
 
 Yr 2 Int: 10%
 
• 
 10% of Yr 1
 
 Diff: +1%
 1% of P = ₹407

**Calculations:**

⇒ D = P × (R ÷ 100)²

⇒ 407 = P × (10 ÷ 100)²

⇒ 407 = P × (1 ÷ 10)²

⇒ 407 = P × (1 ÷ 100)

⇒ P = 407 × 100

⇒ P = 40700

**∴ The correct answer is ₹40,700.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Difference for 3 Years

The difference between compound interest and simple interest on a sum for 3 years is calculated using the formula: D = P × (R ÷ 100)² × (3 + R ÷ 100).

Effective Rate Method

For 2 years, compound interest can be directly computed using the successive percentage change formula: CI% = X + Y + (XY ÷ 100)%.

Half-Yearly Compounding

When compound interest is applied half-yearly, the annual rate of interest is halved (R ÷ 2) and the number of time periods is doubled (2T).

Rule of 72

To quickly estimate the number of years required to double a principal sum at a given compound interest rate, you can use the formula: T ≈ 72 ÷ R.
